# Super Q / Ngosiok Marketing

> Ngosiok Marketing makes Super Q Golden Bihon and Filipino noodles in Cebu, Philippines, since 1945. It is a manufacturer based in Cebu City. Super Q Golden Bihon is a cornstarch-based bihon. The company supplies households, distributors, food-service buyers and export importers, and accepts private label orders at volume.

Key facts:

- Company: NGOSIOK MARKETING. Brand: Super Q. Tagline: "Quality Noodles Since 1945."
- Founded: re-established in Cebu in 1945 after Lucio Ngosiok began noodle making in Cebu City in 1943.
- Office: 325 B. Aranas Street, Cebu City 6000, Philippines. Factory: Cansojong, Talisay City, Cebu.
- Brands: Super Q and Eagle VSP (cornstarch-based noodles); First Choice and Long Life (wheat-based noodles); Golden Q Bihon (budget bihon for Visayas and Mindanao); Q1 (misua).
- Super Q Golden Bihon is made from cornstarch, not rice. Its natural yellow colour comes from the cornstarch. Strands are fine; the block is rectangular, hard and compact, which gives considerable yield.
- Produced through a proprietary process in a controlled environment, which minimises foreign matter from human handling and sun drying.
- Sold across the Philippines and exported internationally. Export cartons carry their own box barcodes (GTIN-14) and published box dimensions.
- Minimum order: one 20-foot container van, around 528 sacks.
- Super Q Golden Bihon has a labeled shelf life of 2 years from production.
- Yield: one 500 g pack of Super Q Golden Bihon feeds at least 5 people.
- Private label packing is accepted for Super Q Golden Bihon, Super Q Pancit Canton and Long Life Pancit Canton with certain order quantities.
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141683048
- Sales contact: sales@ngosiokmarketing.com · +63 (32) 2613233 to 2613235 · +63 917 322 3234

## Products

- [Super Q Golden Bihon](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-golden-bihon): flagship cornstarch-based bihon; 12 kg sacks, 1 kg, 500 g, 454 g and 227 g packs; SRP ₱50 for the 500 g pack
- [Super Q Special Palabok](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-special-palabok): cornstarch noodle, thicker strand than bihon
- [Super Q Pancit Canton](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-pancit-canton): wheat noodle puffed by deep frying; local and export
- [Super Q Sotanghon](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-sotanghon): glass noodles
- [Super Q Misua](https://www.superq.ph/products/super-q-misua): fine wheat-flour noodle, circular shape
- [Q1 Misua](https://www.superq.ph/products/q1-misua): misua, local market
- [Long Life Pancit Canton](https://www.superq.ph/products/long-life-pancit-canton): wheat pancit canton, local market
- [First Choice Fresh Japanese Ramen](https://www.superq.ph/products/first-choice-fresh-japanese-ramen): fresh miki (Hokkien noodles)
- [First Choice Flat Japanese Noodles](https://www.superq.ph/products/first-choice-flat-japanese-noodles): steamed, not fried
- [All products](https://www.superq.ph/products)
